What You’ll Be Owning 

 GRVTY is seeking a UI/UX Developer with a TS/SCI + Poly clearance (applicable to this customer) to join one of our top projects in Chantilly, VA. As a UI/UX Developer in this role, you will be responsible for shaping the user experience and visual design of our digital products. You will conduct user research to understand the needs and behaviors of our audience, then translate those insights into wireframes and interactive prototypes. Your work will focus on creating cohesive, human-centered interfaces that ensure consistency and usability across multiple applications. You will collaborate closely with product managers and developers to implement intuitive solutions that address real user problems. To excel in this position, you should be comfortable working with modern front-end technologies such as React and Next.js, as well as foundational web languages like JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Proficiency with design tools and a strong grasp of color theory and grid systems will enable you to craft visually appealing layouts. Experience in transforming user requirements into functional components, and a keen eye for detail in both design and implementation, will help you deliver seamless, engaging user experiences that align with our brand’s vision.

 What You Must Have 

 
 Active TS/SCI with Polygraph Clearance

 User Research

 Wireframing

 Design Tools

 JavaScript

 TypeScript

 HTML

 CSS

 Front End Technologies (React, Next.js, etc.)

 Color Theory

 Grid Systems

 
 What Would Be Nice to Have 

 
 Experience with prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD)

 Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG, ARIA)

 Experience with responsive and mobile-first design

 Knowledge of design systems and component libraries

 Animation and micro-interaction design skills

 Experience conducting usability testing

 Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies

We’re proud to offer a work environment that empowers our team to achieve a strong work-life balance. GRVTY provides competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for professional growth.
Our benefits package is designed to support the well-being of our employees and their families, and includes coverage in areas such as healthcare, financial wellness, retirement planning, family assistance, continued education, and paid time off.
